outline: Chemical, mechanical and physical properties of cotton, jute, wool, silk, acetate, rayon, polyester, polyamide, acrylic fibers, polyolefin fibers, poly(vinyl alcohol) fibers, elastomeric fibers and aramide fibers will be studied. The tensile, optical, thermal, electrical and mechanical properties of fibers will also be studied.
